notes.title: The Testing Floor - Demo Release!
notes.notes:
Official release of The Testing Floor's demo for the Steam Game Festival!

There will also be a live stream of the developer showcasing the demo and playing through never before seen levels! The live stream will take play June 17th at 7pm CDT, hop to see you there!


TTF Info:

The Testing Floor is a physics-based puzzle-platformer. 

Begin the preliminary testing phase for a prototype called the C.U.B.E.R. Master the projectile-based teleportation system and Power Cube abilities to solve the seemingly endless barrage of puzzle filled floors.


Developer Info:

In January 2016, Nick Maiefski began building The Testing Floor. Over the course of 4 years, with the help of Nolan Brand’s contribution of immersive music and sound effects, The Testing Floor has become a fully realized game.
